TMC Field Supervisor Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Field Supervisor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A1. The post name for the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) Recruitment 2026 is Field Supervisor, for which a walk-in interview is being conducted.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Field Supervisor posts in TMC?
faq.answer: A2. There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Field Supervisor posts in Tata Memorial Centre, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for TMC Field Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: A3. The application mode for the TMC Field Supervisor recruitment is a Walk-in Interview, requiring candidates to report in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for Field Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: A4. The walk-in interview for Field Supervisor posts at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Field Supervisor post at TMC?
faq.answer: A5. The selected candidate for the Field Supervisor post at TMC will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Field Supervisor post?
faq.answer: A6. Candidates must be a Graduate with at least 2 years of relevant experience as a Health Worker or Field Supervisor, along with good communication and MS Office skills.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the TMC Field Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: A7. No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TMC Field Supervisor recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Field Supervisor post?
faq.answer: A8. The selection process for the Field Supervisor post at Tata Memorial Centre is solely based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: A9. The walk-in interview will be conducted at Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: A10. Candidates must carry all original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates, for verification.
